title: Candidature Spontanée – Ingénieur(e)
description:
Candidature Spontanée – Rejoignez NXP Semiconductors en France

Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever un nouveau défi dans l'industrie des semi-conducteurs ?

Chez NXP Semiconductors, nous développons des solutions sécurisées pour un monde plus intelligent. Leader mondial des technologies de connectivité et de sécurité, nous innovons dans les domaines de l'automobile, de l'IoT, des systèmes embarqués et des infrastructures critiques.

Nous constituons actuellement des viviers de talents pour nos futures opportunités en France et recherchons des profils du niveau junior à expérimenté dans nos sites de Toulouse, Caen, Sophia-Antipolis, Grenoble et Paris/Saclay.

DOMAINES D'EXPERTISE RECHERCHÉS
- Conception de circuits intégrés (Analogique, Numérique, Mixte)
- Ingénierie RF & mmWave
- Vérification et validation (Analogique, Numérique, Mixte)
- Layout analogique / numérique
- Produit et test
- Architecture système IC / Logiciel
- Logiciel embarqué & Firmware
- Logiciel système eUICC / e-SIM
- Sécurité HW/SW & Safety
- Program Management
- Business Development & Marketing
- Analystes des activités commerciales
- Field Application Engineers (FAE)
- Account Managers
- IA / ML / Deep Learning

POURQUOI REJOINDRE NXP ?
- Innovation au cœur des technologies de demain : Véhicule connecté, sécurité embarquée, solutions eSIM pour IoT, RF pour 5G et bien plus.
- Un environnement stimulant : Collaboration internationale, projets stratégiques, culture orientée innovation.
- Package attractif : Salaire compétitif, avantages sociaux, télétravail flexible, mobilité internationale.
- Relocation support : Accompagnement pour votre installation si nécessaire.

NOS PROJETS STRATÉGIQUES ACTUELS
- Automobile & Mobilité intelligente
- Sécurité embarquée & cryptographie
- IoT & Connectivité avancée

Vous ne trouvez pas d'offre correspondant à votre profil sur notre site carrière ? Envoyez votre candidature spontanée dès maintenant ! Notre équipe recrutement vous contactera pour explorer les opportunités adaptées à votre parcours.

---

Spontaneous Application – Join NXP Semiconductors in France

At NXP Semiconductors, we develop secure solutions for a smarter world. As a global leader in connectivity and security technologies, we innovate in automotive, IoT, embedded systems, and critical infrastructure.

We are currently building talent pools for future opportunities in France and are looking for junior to experienced profiles across our sites in Toulouse, Caen, Sophia-Antipolis, Grenoble and Paris.

AREAS OF EXPERTISE WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Analog/Digital/Mixed-Signal IC Design, RF & mmWave IC Design, Analog/Digital/Mixed-Signal Verification & Validation, Analog/Digital Layout, Product and Test Engineering, System IC Architect / Software Architect, Embedded Software & Firmware, eUICC / eSIM System Software, Hardware/Software Security & Functional Safety, Program Management, Business Development & Marketing, Sales Operations Analyst, Field Application Engineers (FAE), Account Managers.

WHY JOIN NXP?
Innovation at the heart of tomorrow's technologies (connected vehicles, embedded security, eSIM solutions for IoT, RF for 5G), international collaboration, competitive package, relocation support if required.

STRATEGIC FOCUS AREAS: Automotive & Smart Mobility / Embedded Security & Cryptography / IoT & Advanced Connectivity (eSIM/eUICC solutions and RF technologies for 5G).

ai_analysis.summary: Roughly a 55-60% fit: the candidate's strong Linux kernel/driver, embedded firmware, and ASIC-adjacent systems programming background aligns well with NXP's embedded software, system architecture, and HW/SW security tracks. However, the posting also spans analog/RF IC design, layout, eSIM/eUICC software, and business-facing roles where the candidate has no relevant experience, making this a partial match at best across the full breadth of the posting.
resume_tips: Add explicit 'firmware' and 'embedded Linux' keywords near the top of the resume since NXP's ATS likely filters on these terms.
Quantify the impact of the Arista ASIC register management work (e.g. number of registers, chips supported, time saved) to strengthen the System IC Architecture match.
Promote the RFID Linux kernel driver and STM32 UART/I2C projects above general software projects (EpiTweet, Tiger Compiler) since they map directly to NXP's Embedded Software & Firmware track.

Explicitly mention 'device driver development' and 'hardware/software security' as skill labels, since My Docker (namespaces/seccomp/cgroups) is relevant to NXP's Security & Safety domain but currently framed as a generic systems project.
If pursuing NXP's Verification & Validation track, surface debugging/testing tools (GDB, strace, valgrind) more prominently — currently buried in a generic 'Other/DevOps' skill bucket.

Since NXP also recruits for RF/analog/layout and business roles, be explicit in the cover letter that you are targeting the Embedded Software / System Architecture / Security tracks specifically, to avoid ATS misrouting.
ai_analysis.recommended_profile: Looking for a full-time position in software engineering with a focus on embedded Linux, hardware interfacing, firmware development. MSc in Computer Engineering (EPITA - GISTRE) in Systems / Embedded. Fluent in French and English (TOEIC 915, C1). Interests: watchmaking, music, hiking/running, cooking.
